# Everything a real robots.txt gets wrong, in one file: a rule before any
# group, a line with no colon, a value that is not a number, a field nobody
# defined, and a sitemap. None of it may raise, and the one good group still
# has to bind. RFC 9309 section 2.2.4.
Disallow: /orphan/
User-agent yen-idhazh
Disallow /nocolon/
Crawl-delay: soon
# a comment
User-agent: *
Disallow: /private/
Unknown-Field: whatever
Sitemap: https://x.example/sitemap.xml
